integrity: The complete executable C++17 reverse-pair-graph verifier, independent small-case reverse oracle, independent long-distance forward oracle, complete 1000-row data and output are embedded; no external proof artifacts needed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem only for integer k from 1 through 1000; finite exhaustive computation is not an all-k argument. The 2018 originating thesis could not be inspected; unindexed equivalent computations remain a priority risk; independently validated status is not claimed.
title: Exact pair-merging diameters and unique extremizers for one thousand Dżyga–Szykuła automata
